{{Top|leg}}
'''Personnel carriers''' were inexpensive tracked or wheeled military or law enforcement transports, used by small or poor worlds that couldn't afford [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].

The term referred to many models of [[Groundcar/Legends|groundcars]] used for the task. Usually simple and reliable, crewed by two (pilot and co-pilot), with a passenger capacity between 4 and 15 creatures (depending on the cargo space), no weapons, a cost of 3000 credits and some room for customization.
